properties.ReviewerComment: There is no dam on Shell Creek (I’ve done salmon surveys there for last 5 years). There is a pond that is fed by a pipe into south side of the creek, but it does not impede or change creek natural flow.  There is also a wetland just to the north of the creek outlet culvert. The pond is totally freshwater and has no tidal influx - it is fed from the south end with small channel off the main creek and drains back to creek through an underground pipe upstream of any tidal influence.
